fixture.title: Inspired by Stripe — reference components
fixture.description:
Reference fixture for design-systems/stripe. Every visible
        value comes from tokens.css; the page itself follows Stripe's
        rules — sohne-var with ss01 globally, weight 300 at display
        sizes, deep navy (#061b31) headings instead of black, blue-
        tinted multi-layer shadows on elevated surfaces, conservative
        4-8px radius, and Stripe Purple capped at ≤2 visible uses
        per screen.

selectors: * weight-400 sohne-var with ss01. Hover shifts background * colour; never transforms. Primary uses --accent / --accent-on; * ghost uses the brand purple as text colour against a * transparent shell with a purple-tinted border. */ .btn

/* :root paste — sourced verbatim from design-systems/stripe/tokens.css. Keep this block in sync when tokens.css changes. The agent prompt instructs the Designer panelist to paste this block as the FIRST thing in their <style>
/* Compact button for nav and toolbar — 14px / 4px radius */ .btn-sm
/* Ghost / outlined — DESIGN.md §4 spec verbatim. The hover wash is the only place we tint --accent with transparency inline; it's a once-per-page rule rather than a cross-component pattern
/* Pricing-style featured card row — exercises .card-elevated alongside .card so the elevation contrast is visible. */ .pricing-grid
/* `.eyebrow` is the only place uppercase + tracking is used — small label

/* identifier */ /* ─── Metric (tabular financial rendering) ────────────────── * DESIGN.md §3 "Caption Tabular" — `tnum` for any number in * a data display so columns of figures align. The values use * deep navy; the labels use slate. */ .metric
/* never 600/700 in sohne-var per DESIGN.md §7 */ /* ─── Layout primitives ─────────────────────────────────────── */ .container
/* ─── Badges ──────────────────────────────────────────────── * Success badge per DESIGN.md §4. Pill radius is wrong here — * Stripe uses 4px on badges
/* ─── Buttons ─────────────────────────────────────────────── * Stripe buttons are conservative — 4px radius

/* ─── Code block ──────────────────────────────────────────── * DESIGN.md §3: SourceCodePro at 12px / weight 500 / 2.00 * line-height. The 2.00 leading is intentional — Stripe's * payment-integration snippets need to read like prose

/* ─── Distinctive brand element: gradient halo ────────────── * Stripe's signature hero decoration is a soft pastel wash * behind the headline — built here from the brand purple * mixed at varying transparencies (no raw hex outside :root). * The halo sits in a layered radial-gradient and lets the * navy headline read as "floating in twilight". */ .halo
/* ─── Links ───────────────────────────────────────────────── * Default link is Stripe Purple. Underline appears only on * hover
at a generous offset so the rule reads as a * deliberate gesture. */ a

blue-tinted multi-layer shadow — * for featured / hero cards where Stripe's * trademark elevation does the work. * Both share radius and padding. Hover on .card-elevated * intensifies the shadow; .card stays static (border doesn't * pulse). */ .card
deep-navy on lavender wash. tracking is well above the craft 0.06em floor. */ .eyebrow
navy text. Stripe's * kbd is small and dense — no padding inflation. */ kbd
no shadow — for grids and * form panels where the border IS the edge. * .card-elevated no border
so it stays inline rather than being promoted to a token. */ .btn-ghost
then reference everything below via var(...). */ :root
